name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Most of what this role does day to day, building audience lists, launching ad and email campaigns, producing client reports, and keeping a queue of requests moving, is work I've done hands-on. At Level Agency I managed accounts spending $20K+ a month on ads, ran account-based LinkedIn campaigns against researched audience lists, and reported results in QBRs. At Solenzo I build segmented email campaigns and automated follow-up for clients and track every request until it's closed.

On the customer success side, I onboarded and supported 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye and kept all but one, and at Wix I managed about 25 concurrent onboardings at peak. I use AI tools every day to move faster and build automations to cut repetitive steps, which matters on a team with this much task volume.

My background runs deeper than an associate role usually asks for, and I'm applying on purpose: I want to work on the customer side of a data and advertising platform, and I'd rather earn my way into a CSM seat by doing the operational work well than skip it. I haven't worked in automotive, but dealerships are the kind of busy, local business I've supported for years. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
